text: {boss} wants everyone running hills at 6 a.m. before school. It's dark, the grass is wet and cold.

up.label: Run them backwards with a weighted vest

risk.result: A hamstring. In week one.

text: Your ankle rolls under you in a pack. You hop out. It's swelling like a balloon in your sock.

risk.result: Now it's a fracture. Six weeks in a boot.
It didn't go to plan.

up.label: Tape it and kick the winning goal

risk.result: It snaps. You are out for the season.

text: {rival} and you both play wing. There's one spot on the sheet this week. You both eye the clipboard.

left.label: Bump in training
left.result: {rival} hits the turf. You get the spot, and a look.

up.label: Challenge {rival} to a one-on-one for the spot

risk.result: They win. In front of {boss}.

text: Your family's on canteen duty, selling pies. They cheer very loudly at every mark you take.

risk.result: You paid for it later.

up.label: Invite them to sing the club song on the ground

risk.result: The whole ground films it.

text: {boss} hands you a laminated gym program. It is mostly squats. The last page just says "SQUATS".

up.label: Hire a pro trainer and double it

risk.result: Overtrained. A stress fracture.

text: You get collected in a marking contest. The sky spins. The lights look funny. There are two umpires.

risk.result: You weren't fine. Two weeks in a dark room.
Then it went a bit wrong.

up.label: Retire for a season and study the brain

risk.result: Your spot goes to {rival}.

text: The rep team list goes up on the clubroom door. Kids crowd in. Your heart is thumping.

risk.result: You paid for it later.
Your name isn't there. {rival}'s is.

up.label: Ask {boss} to put you straight in the A squad

risk.result: They put you in the C squad out of spite.

text: Rep carnival interstate. Four nights in a cheap motel with the squad and one very tired manager.

risk.result: {boss} benches the whole room.

up.label: Run the team's talent night

risk.result: {boss} sees the footage at breakfast.

text: {rival} is telling the scouts you can't kick on your left. Loudly. Next to the canteen.

risk.result: Mostly fine. Mostly.

up.label: Kick a goal from the boundary, left foot

risk.result: It sails into the stands. In front of the scouts.

text: A recruiter sits in the stands with a little notebook. Every time you touch the ball, the pen moves.

risk.result: There was a catch.
You come down on your shoulder. Hard.

up.label: Play like it's your last game

risk.result: A heavy collision ends your match.

text: Draft combine. Clipboards and stopwatches everywhere. They time everything, even how you breathe.

up.label: Break the record

risk.result: A torn quad, mid-sprint. Draft stock plummets.

text: A journalist pushes a microphone at you. Cameras click. Which club would you love to be drafted to?

right.label: Name your team
right.result: Three other clubs quietly cross you off.

up.label: Say you'd play for any club for free

risk.result: It becomes a headline. Clubs lower the offer.

text: New tyres cost more than your parents' car payment. Your old ones are bald and shiny. Race is Sunday.

risk.result: Bald tyre, wet corner, wall.

up.label: Skip qualifying and save the budget

risk.result: You start last. You finish last.

text: Lights out. Twelve karts scream towards one tight first corner. There's a gap. Nearly a gap.

risk.result: Three karts in the tyre wall. Yours is upside down.

up.label: Go round the outside at full speed

risk.result: Wall. Kart destroyed. Ambulance.

text: A local tiling company might put its logo on your helmet. The logo is a smiling tile with arms.

right.label: Pitch them
right.result: You now say "Tiles by Terry" in every interview.

up.label: Pitch the whole high street

risk.result: They all say no. At once.

text: Through the kitchen door you hear your parents, quietly, about the house and your racing.

up.label: Race for free tonight and prove you're worth it

risk.result: You crash. They cry. The house stays on the market.

text: {rival} is in the same team, same kart, and half a second quicker. The timesheet gloats.

up.label: Ask to swap karts for a week

risk.result: They're faster in yours. Now what?

text: {boss} says your neck wobbles in the corners. There's a harness with weights. It looks medieval.

up.label: Train with a pro driver for a month

risk.result: A whiplash injury on day nine.

text: The engine goes bang on lap three. Blue smoke, a rattle, silence. That was expensive.

up.label: Build a new engine from scrap

risk.result: It blows again. And again. Worse.

text: A sim rig would let you learn every track from your bedroom. Wheel, pedals, bolted seat. Small bedroom.

up.label: Build your own rig and stream the practice

risk.result: Nobody watches. The rig overheats.

text: Last race of the regional season. You lead by two points. Second place is close enough to read your stickers.

risk.result: Then it went a bit wrong.
You touch wheels. Both of you fly.

up.label: Pass {rival} at the last corner

risk.result: You clip wheels. Both of you spin. Neither wins.

text: Rain, 140 km/h, spray everywhere. The kart twitches. The barrier is coming up fast.

death.cause: Crashed in the wet at a junior race.

up.label: Floor it through the spray

risk.result: Barriers. Fire. A long hospital stay.

text: A real single-seater team offers a test day. Real car, real track. You pay for the fuel. All of it.

up.label: Drive flat out and set a lap record

risk.result: You crash the team's car.

text: {boss} has a seat for next season. The budget is more than your house. Your parents go quiet.

up.label: Take the seat and sell the family house

risk.result: The season ends. So does your family's patience.

text: {boss} blows the whistle. Suicides until someone throws up. The gym smells of sweat and polish.

up.label: Beat everyone and then run another set

risk.result: You pull a calf. {boss} says nothing.

text: You land wrong on a rebound. Your knee makes a noise like snapping celery. The gym goes quiet.

risk.result: Torn ligament. Season's over.
Not everything went your way.

up.label: Get the surgery and rebuild your game

risk.result: The surgery works. The spot is gone.

text: {rival} never passes. Ever. Not even when you're wide open, waving like you're landing a plane.

risk.result: It didn't go to plan.

up.label: Get the team to freeze them out

risk.result: {boss} calls it mutiny. You lose your place.

text: Down by one, no time left. Two free throws. The gym is silent. Somebody drops a juice box.

left.label: Underhand, granny style
left.result: Both go in. Nobody can say anything.

risk.result: Front rim. Back rim. Out.

up.label: Shoot it with your eyes shut

risk.result: An air ball. A groan. A silence.

text: You've never dunked. Now it's a breakaway, nobody between you and the hoop, and the crowd is up.

risk.result: Rim 1, you 0. It's on someone's phone.

up.label: Go for the windmill

risk.result: You crash into the stanchion.

text: Everyone on the team has the new signature shoes but you. Yours have tape on the toe.

up.label: Make a pair for yourself and film it

risk.result: They fall apart mid-game.

text: There's a summer shooting camp with real coaches. It costs a lot of mowing money. A lot of lawns.

risk.result: It didn't go to plan.

up.label: Get a pro coach for a month and train twice a day

risk.result: Burnout in week three.

text: State squad trials. Two hundred kids in bibs, fifteen spots, coaches frowning in the stands.

risk.result: Then it went a bit wrong.
Three bricks in a row. Someone laughs.

up.label: Play for the highlight reel

risk.result: You turn it over four times. They notice.

text: You made state. You've played four minutes all tournament. Your warm-up top has never been warmer.

up.label: Demand a trial against the starters

risk.result: You fail the trial. In front of the whole squad.

text: A college scout messages you. They love your game. Their account has eleven followers and no photo.

risk.result: Then it went a bit wrong.
They want a "recruiting fee". It was a scam.

up.label: Drive to meet them in person

risk.result: The scout is a catfish. Or a cousin.

text: A real college flies you out. Big arena, free hoodie, a chocolate fountain. Everything is free.

up.label: Sign on the spot

risk.result: The offer wasn't what they said.

text: {rival} got the same college offer. One scholarship left. You pass at practice without a word.

risk.result: There was a catch.
Everyone knows it was you.

up.label: Challenge {rival} to a winner-takes-all game

risk.result: You lose. The scout is there. It's recorded.

text: The band needs a name. {rival} wants "Mouldy Toast". They've already drawn the logo. It has a face.

risk.result: Then it went a bit wrong.

up.label: Fire {rival} and rename it

risk.result: Half the band leaves with the name.

text: The neighbour has called about the drums again. Third time this week. He's waving the phone at you.

up.label: Move the band to a real rehearsal room

risk.result: The room's deposit is a month's pay.

text: First gig. Nine people in the room, and four are your family. Your nan brought a sign.

risk.result: Nine people is not enough to catch you.

up.label: Play the whole set in the crowd

risk.result: Somebody steps on the amp. Smoke.

text: 2 a.m. A song is half-written in your notes app. One verse is just "something about rain".

up.label: Record it and upload it before morning

risk.result: You wake up. You listen. You delete it.

text: Your cover of an old song is doing numbers. Small numbers, but numbers. Someone wrote "this slaps".

risk.result: There was a catch.

up.label: Release a full album of covers

risk.result: A copyright claim from a ninety-year-old.

text: Battle of the bands in a sticky hall. The prize is studio time. The last band had a smoke machine.

risk.result: It didn't go to plan.
Caught on camera. Disqualified.

up.label: Play a ten-minute free-form suite

risk.result: The judges stop listening at minute four.

text: {rival} wants a guitar solo in every song. Every one. Even the slow one about your nan's dog.

up.label: Give them a solo and write one for yourself

risk.result: The two solos fight. The band does too.

text: A man in sunglasses wants to be your manager. Indoors. At night. His business cards are handwritten.

risk.result: It didn't go to plan.
He took 60%. Of everything. Forever.

up.label: Counter-offer: you sign him

risk.result: He has no clients. He has a fax machine.

text: A pub gig pays real money. The stage is two pallets. You're technically too young to be inside.

risk.result: The licensing officer was in the crowd.

up.label: Play three sets a night for the week

risk.result: Your voice goes. So does the residency.

text: An old post of yours resurfaces, screenshotted and shared everywhere. It is very, very bad.

up.label: Turn it into a song

risk.result: The song goes viral. So does the scandal.

text: The label wants a second demo by Friday. It's Tuesday. The drummer has a cold.

risk.result: It didn't go to plan.

up.label: Send the live version from last night

risk.result: The tape includes a lot of coughing.

text: The label wants you. Just you. Not the band. The band is outside, eating chips, waiting.

up.label: Counter: sign the whole band or nothing

risk.result: They pull the offer for all of you.

text: Background extra. Your job is to walk past a café with an empty cup. Forty times. Again.

up.label: Slip into the lead's shot

risk.result: You are escorted off set by security.

text: Audition. You pour your heart out. The casting director eats soup the whole time and slurps the sad bit.

risk.result: You paid for it later.
"Thank you. Next." The soup continues.

up.label: Do it in a mad accent

risk.result: The soup goes cold. So does the room.

text: Your agent winces at your headshots. They look like a school photo. Bad fringe and everything.

up.label: Do your own shoot and sell prints

risk.result: One shot is flattering. It's of someone else.

text: {rival} got the callback you wanted. Now they're holding out the script, asking you to run lines.

risk.result: Mostly fine. Mostly.

up.label: Swap their audition time with yours

risk.result: They catch you. Through the office door.

text: The director needs you to cry on cue. Now. Thirty crew are waiting and the light is fading.

risk.result: It didn't go to plan.

up.label: Cry, then ask for a retake in tears

risk.result: You can't stop. The crew waits an hour.

text: The shoot runs into exam week. The schedule and your revision timetable overlap on the fridge.

up.label: Pay a tutor and do both

risk.result: You fail one exam. And the shoot is a blur.

text: You're cast in a yoghurt ad. One line: "Mmm". You must say it convincingly, with a spoon, eleven takes.

risk.result: Mostly fine. Mostly.

right.label: Full-body mmm
right.result: It airs during the footy. Your school will never forget.

up.label: Make it a viral dance

risk.result: The meme is unkind. The brand pulls the ad.

text: Someone in the cereal aisle points: "Yoghurt kid!" Three people turn round. One is holding yoghurt.

risk.result: It didn't go to plan.

up.label: Start a fan club

risk.result: A fan follows you home. Twice.

text: A gossip page says you were rude to a fan. You weren't. Mostly. You were hungry and had a cold.

risk.result: Now it's a bigger story.
Then it went a bit wrong.

up.label: Go on live TV and tell your side

risk.result: The host asks about your ex.

text: TV bit part. You have three lines, and one is "Look out!" You've said it in the mirror two hundred times.

risk.result: You paid for it later.
Your line is cut. So is your scene.

up.label: Steal the scene with a mad ad-lib

risk.result: The lead storms off. The scene is cut.

text: Your co-star is {crush}. The director wants more chemistry. The whole set pretends not to watch.

up.label: Kiss {crush} in the scene, off script

risk.result: Slap. Take two. Then lawyers.

text: Your agent wants you to change your name. And your nose. They say it casually, buttering a roll.

risk.result: There was a catch.

up.label: Go independent and produce your own film

risk.result: Nobody watches it. Not even you.

text: {boss} says watch the corner. Whistle if you see blue. The streetlight buzzes. Your phone is on 12%.

risk.result: Then it went a bit wrong.

up.label: Tip off the cops instead

risk.result: {boss} finds out who tipped. It's you.

text: {boss} hands you a taped-up bag, heavier than it looks. "Don't open it. Don't drop it."

up.label: Open it and sell what's inside

risk.result: {boss} finds out. Quickly.

death.cause: It was {boss}'s money. They came for it.

text: Kids at school whisper when you walk past. Some move seats at lunch. A teacher stares a bit too long.

up.label: Use the rumour to run the lunch-hall

risk.result: A teacher calls the police.

text: Your mum finds a roll of cash in your sock drawer. She's standing in your doorway, holding it up.

up.label: Hand her the whole lot as rent

risk.result: She can't take it. She knows what it's from.

text: {boss} wants the servo's back door left unlocked tonight. The owner always gives you free slushies.

up.label: Warn the shop owner at the last minute

risk.result: {boss} finds out. {boss} finds you.

death.cause: The crew found out who warned the shop.

text: A police officer stops you on the way home, notebook out. "Know anything about the servo?"

risk.result: Word gets back. Someone visits you after school.

up.label: Cut a deal and name {boss}

risk.result: Word spreads. Fast.

death.cause: The crew do not forgive informants.

text: You count the takings twice. {rival} has been skimming. Their new trainers are very white.

risk.result: Mostly fine. Mostly.

up.label: Join {rival} and skim twice as much

risk.result: Caught. Both of you. In the car park.

text: {rival} told {boss} the missing money was you. {boss} is staring at you. Nobody is talking.

risk.result: {boss} doesn't believe you. It's a long night.

up.label: Frame {rival} right back with proof

risk.result: Both of you pay. In more ways than money.

text: You're a runner now. {boss} tosses you keys to a car with a cracked windscreen. You're fifteen.

risk.result: You meet a power pole.

up.label: Take the car and leave town

risk.result: {boss} has friends in the next town.

text: {friend} knows a youth worker who can get you an apprenticeship. Real pay. Away from all this.

right.label: Get out
right.result: {boss} lets you walk. You still check over your shoulder.

up.label: Go to the police station together

risk.result: The crew finds out first.

text: To be crew, {boss} says you need to prove yourself. Tonight. The others watch from the bench.

risk.result: Walking away has a price.

up.label: Rob the crew's rival and own the block

risk.result: Their turf. Their rules. Their fists.

death.cause: The rival crew caught you alone.

text: Squad cars keep cruising your street, slowly, every hour. Curtains twitch. {boss} says lie low.

up.label: Burn the evidence and run the block

risk.result: The cops found the burn. And you.

text: The big bowl. Tail on the edge, toes over nothing. Everyone's watching. {friend} says just commit.

risk.result: You committed. Your wrist did not.

up.label: Drop in and straight into a 360

risk.result: Hospital. The bowl has your blood on it.

death.cause: You landed on your head. The helmet was in your bag.

text: Security says the plaza isn't a skatepark. Perfect ledges, smooth stairs. It's a very good skatepark.

risk.result: Mostly fine. Mostly.
That was a fine, not a warning.

up.label: Lead everyone into the plaza

risk.result: Fines for the whole crew. Yours is the biggest.

text: {friend} has a camera and a plan. You need one clip that isn't a slam. The battery's on one bar.

risk.result: There was a catch.

right.label: Try it forty times
right.result: Try forty-one. It's on the internet now.

up.label: Do it off a rooftop for one clip

risk.result: You get the clip. And a cast.

text: Your deck snapped clean in half like a biscuit. A new one costs ninety. You have about six.

up.label: Build your own from scrap and sell them

risk.result: It splits on the first kickflip.

text: {rival} lands your trick. Your trick. On your ledge. Then they do a little bow.

risk.result: Bigger, yes. Landed, no.

up.label: Challenge {rival} to a game of S.K.A.T.E.

risk.result: You lose on the last letter.

text: Your parents watched one video of you falling down stairs. Just one. They have opinions. And leaflets.

left.label: Wear the helmet
left.result: You look safe. Deeply uncool, but safe.

up.label: Ask them to film your next session

risk.result: They film a fall and share it with the family.

text: {boss} from the skate shop offers you free wheels every month. Flow, they call it.

risk.result: You paid for it later.

up.label: Ask for a full sponsorship deal

risk.result: {boss} hears 'greedy'. The wheels go to {rival}.

text: Am contest. Two minutes, one run, three judges with clipboards and sunburn. The crowd is loud.

risk.result: Then it went a bit wrong.
The hammer won. You lost.

up.label: Skip your best run and land the 900

risk.result: You crash into the judges.

text: Team tour. Eight skaters, one van, no air con. The windows only open halfway. It smells already.

up.label: Drive the van and plan the whole tour

risk.result: The van breaks down in the middle of nowhere.

text: {boss} wants to put your name on a board. An actual board, on the shop wall, for sale.

left.label: Design it yourself
left.result: It's a raccoon on fire. It sells out.

up.label: Design it and launch your own brand

risk.result: The graphics are banned. The stock is gone.

text: Five ranked losses in a row. Your hands are sweaty. One more and you drop a tier.

risk.result: Then it went a bit wrong.
You dropped a tier. Also, it's 3 a.m.

up.label: Change role and play something new

risk.result: You lose again. In a new role.

text: Your back hurts after every session. A real gaming chair costs two hundred and fifty. You're on a stool.

left.label: Sit on a pillow
left.result: The pillow is doing its best.

up.label: Start a stretching channel and a sponsor

risk.result: Nobody watches. You still sit badly.

text: A stranger in chat has thoughts about your mother. Many thoughts. All caps, bad spelling.

risk.result: It didn't go to plan.

right.label: Type back
right.result: You won the argument. You lost the game.

up.label: Clip it and build a 'worst chat' series

risk.result: Now the whole chat is after you.

text: {friend} says you should stream. Eleven people would watch. Maybe twelve, if your nan logs on.

right.label: Go live
right.result: Nine people. One was your mum.

up.label: Stream for 24 hours straight

risk.result: You faint on camera.

text: Your parents cut the wifi at 10 p.m. Scrims start at 10:30. Your team is already in voice chat.

risk.result: There was a catch.

up.label: Move in with a teammate for the season

risk.result: Your parents stop talking to you.

text: {rival} is on a secret account, farming low ranks and laughing about it. The victims are about twelve.

risk.result: Not everything went your way.

up.label: Challenge {rival} live on stream

risk.result: They smurfed in the duel. You lose by 20.

text: An academy team wants a tryout. {boss} is right behind you, watching every click.

risk.result: The highlight was you dying first.

up.label: Call the whole strategy yourself

risk.result: The call is wrong. {boss} stops watching.

text: Your wrist clicks when you click. Every single time. You hear it in your sleep. That seems bad.

up.label: Switch to a brand new playstyle and rest

risk.result: It never feels right again.

text: First LAN final. Real stage, real lights, and a trophy shaped like a sword. Your mouse hand shakes.

risk.result: It's a famous clip now. For the wrong reasons.

up.label: Pull off a trick nobody has tried

risk.result: It fails. On stage. In front of 3,000.

text: {boss} offers a pro contract. Gaming house, salary, a chef who only makes pasta. School's not done.

up.label: Negotiate the contract and a bonus for school

risk.result: They withdraw. Nobody negotiates with you.
